name: heavy-bomber
title: Heavy bomber (mission 1 raid)
usage: Mission 1: six bombers in formation (required targets, never fire). Pending review; not referenced from src/.

noText.note: No letters, numbers, call signs, serials, squadron codes or glyph-like marks in mesh or texture; grey countershading, splinter camouflage, panel lines and stains only.

noLogosOrBrands.note: No company, product or brand marks; colour fields and wear only.

noRealMilitaryInsignia.note: No roundels, flags, national or unit markings; the only markings are a plain dark-red fin-tip band and plain rings on the engine lips. Airframe is an original design, not a copy of any real or game aircraft (podded turbofans, shoulder wing, low tailplanes).

noFaces.note: No faces or figures: no crew is modelled; the windscreen is one continuous framed band and the refuelling probe is offset to starboard; engine fronts are four small dark fan discs in a row.

noSuggestiveShapes.note: Ordinary hard-surface or natural forms reviewed in all four previews.

noGoreOrWeaponsGlorification.note: Unarmed airframe: no guns, turret, missiles or visible bombs; bomb-bay doors are closed panel lines. No kill marks, damage or gore.

originalDesign.note: Authored procedurally in tools/assets from original dimensions; no third-party meshes or scans.

design: Original four-turbofan heavy bomber: shoulder-mounted 33-degree swept wing, slight anhedral, podded engines on pylons, swept fin, low tailplanes, gear sponsons. 72 studs span = 2.9x Vanta v2 (24.6) and 3.2x Kestrel v2 (22.2).
